en: Color postcard showing a lively pedestrian street in Sibiu with crowds walking along a wet, sunlit roadway lined with historic buildings. A large storefront sign reads "Magazin universal." The reverse bears Romanian text identifying the People's Republic of Romania, a 40-bani airmail stamp of R.P. Romînă (bobsleigh motif), a circular postmark, and a handwritten message and address to Bucharest.
